verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs state that ACH transfers take 1–3 business days, that domestic and international wires can send same-day, and that users see the exact delivery estimate before confirming. That matches the story directly, but it rests on a single first-party sentence. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the estimate is shown in the confirmation flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the pre-confirmation estimate appears for both ACH and wires.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can see the exact delivery estimate for an ACH or wire transfer before confirming it

citations.quote: ACH transfers take 1–3 business days; wires (domestic and international) can send same-day. You'll see the exact delivery estimate before confirming.
